indications: bipolar depression maintenance/prevention of depressive episodes (first-line)

SJS.note: Risk of serious rash (SJS/TEN) ~0.8-1 in 1000 in adults; risk reduced by slow titration; risk increased with valproate co-prescription, rapid escalation, or exceeding recommended titration

adverse_effects.management: stop immediately if any sign of hypersensitivity syndrome or mucosal involvement; urgent medical assessment
